mapper.sql: al.round = (SELECT MAX(r.round) FROM approval_line r WHERE r.doc_id = d.doc_id)

al.round = COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(r.round) FROM approval_line r WHERE r.doc_id = d.doc_id AND (d.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') OR r.approval_status <> 'PENDING')), (SELECT MAX(r2.round) FROM approval_line r2 WHERE r2.doc_id = d.doc_id))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document ( document_type, title, content, employee_id, approval_type, status, is_urgent, due_date ) VALUES ( #{documentType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{employeeId}, #{approvalType}, #{status}, #{isUrgent}, #{dueDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT d.*, al.approval_line_id, al.approver_id, al.approval_order, al.round, al.approval_status, e.name, e.position, t.team_name, vr.vacation_id, vr.vacation_type_id, vr.start_date, vr.end_date, vr.days, vr.reason, vr.start_half, vr.end_half, vt.type_name, vt.deduct_balance FROM document d LEFT JOIN approval_line al ON d.doc_id = al.doc_id AND LEFT JOIN employee e ON al.approver_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN team t ON e.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN vacation_request vr ON d.doc_id = vr.doc_id LEFT JOIN vacation_type vt ON vr.vacation_type_id = vt.vacation_type_id WHERE d.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND d.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY al.approval_order
SELECT MAX(round) FROM approval_line WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO approval_line (doc_id, approver_id, approval_order, round, approval_type, approval_status) VALUES
(#{line.docId}, #{line.approverId}, #{line.approvalOrder}, #{line.round}, #{line.approvalType}, #{line.approvalStatus})
mapper.update:
UPDATE document SET status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW(), title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_urgent = #{isUrgent}, due_date = #{dueDate}, approval_type = #{approvalType} WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId}
AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT al.approval_line_id, al.approver_id, al.approval_order, al.round, al.approval_status, al.comment, al.approved_at, e.name, e.position, t.team_name FROM approval_line al JOIN employee e ON al.approver_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN team t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE al.doc_id = #{docId} AND al.approval_status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY al.round, al.approval_order
mapper.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT al2.doc_id FROM approval_line al2 JOIN document pd ON pd.doc_id = al2.doc_id JOIN employee pe ON pd.employee_id = pe.employee_id WHERE al2.approver_id = #{employeeId} AND al2.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND pd.status = 'PENDING' AND (pd.approval_type = 'PARALLEL'
OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_line prev WHERE prev.doc_id = al2.doc_id AND prev.round = al2.round AND prev.approval_order < al2.approval_order AND prev.approval_status != 'APPROVED'))
AND (pd.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{p.keyword}, '%') OR pe.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{p.keyword}, '%'))
AND pd.document_type = #{p.docType}
mapper.select: SELECT d.doc_id, d.title, d.document_type, d.status,d.due_date, d.is_urgent, d.approval_type, d.employee_id, d.created_at, d.updated_at, de.name AS drafter_name, de.position AS drafter_position, dt.team_name AS drafter_team, al.approval_line_id, al.approver_id, al.approval_order, al.round, al.approval_status, e.name, e.position, t.team_name,d.content, al.comment, al.approved_at, vr.vacation_id, vr.vacation_type_id, vr.start_date, vr.end_date, vr.days, vr.reason, vr.start_half, vr.end_half, vt.type_name,vt.deduct_balance FROM document d JOIN employee de ON d.employee_id = de.employee_id LEFT JOIN team dt ON de.team_id = dt.team_id JOIN approval_line al ON d.doc_id = al.doc_id AND JOIN employee e ON al.approver_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN team t ON e.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN vacation_request vr ON d.doc_id = vr.doc_id LEFT JOIN vacation_type vt ON vr.vacation_type_id = vt.vacation_type_id WHERE d.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY al.approval_order
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_line SET approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, comment = #{comment}, approved_at = NOW() WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND approver_id = #{approverId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING' AND doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM document WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND status = 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_line WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING' AND round = (SELECT MAX(r.round) FROM approval_line r WHERE r.doc_id = #{docId})
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_line SET approval_status = 'CANCELED' WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING' AND round = (SELECT MAX(r.round) FROM (SELECT round, doc_id FROM approval_line) r WHERE r.doc_id = #{docId})
UPDATE document SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vacation_request ( doc_id, employee_id, vacation_type_id,start_date ,end_date,start_half ,end_half, days,reason ) VALUES ( #{docId}, #{employeeId}, #{vacationTypeId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{startHalf}, #{endHalf}, #{days}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 'APPROVED' THEN vr.days ELSE 0 END) AS usedDays, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 'PENDING' THEN vr.days ELSE 0 END) AS pendingDays FROM vacation_request vr JOIN document d ON d.doc_id = vr.doc_id JOIN vacation_type vt ON vt.vacation_type_id = vr.vacation_type_id WHERE vr.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND vt.deduct_balance = 1

SELECT vr.*, vt.type_name, d.status, DATE_FORMAT(vr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_at FROM vacation_request vr JOIN document d ON d.doc_id = vr.doc_id JOIN vacation_type vt ON vt.vacation_type_id = vr.vacation_type_id WHERE vr.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY vr.vacation_id DESC
